note: Curated daily. Headlines are paraphrased; open the source for the full story.

items.title: EU and UK agree to link their emissions trading systems from 2028
items.summary: Allowances from either ETS would count for compliance in both markets once the link starts at the beginning of 2028. The UK will also extend its scheme to maritime and aviation, adding roughly 10 Mt CO2, and estimates the deal could add up to £3.8bn a year to its economy by 2040.

items.title: US Labor Department proposes stripping ESG language from its 401(k) investment rule
items.summary: The proposal would reverse the 2022 ERISA rule that let retirement-plan fiduciaries weigh ESG factors, and put more scrutiny on fund managers' shareholder engagement and proxy voting. A 60-day comment period opens on Federal Register publication.

items.title: Ardian raises €230 million for nature-based carbon removal strategy
items.summary: The 'Averrhoa NBS' strategy aims to cut 85 million tonnes of carbon over 40 years through forest, mangrove and wetland restoration. IFC, EIB, Proparco and British International Investment are among new investors, with Société Générale as anchor.

items.title: COP31 ends in Antalya without a cover decision — first such failure since Copenhagen
items.summary: After the longest COP on record, the EU, UK and dozens of climate-vulnerable nations rejected the proposed 'Antalya pact', which omitted fossil fuels and dropped the $120bn adaptation-finance tripling target. Technical decisions on just transition, the adaptation goal, a climate finance work programme and Article 6 carbon markets were still adopted.

items.title: Kolkata CSR 'unconference' looks at funding West Bengal's impact economy
items.summary: Hosted by Techno India University's Atal Innovation Mission-backed incubator, the event covered Schedule VII opportunities and regulatory pathways, with an impact pitch session for social enterprises and non-profits; Dr Bhaskar Chatterjee gave the keynote.

items.title: Muthoot Finance launches 'ASHA Shakti', honouring 239 ASHA workers in Ernakulam
items.summary: The new CSR programme recognises senior community health workers in Kerala's Ernakulam district, with ₹30 lakh earmarked for its first phase.

items.title: MCA floats a sweeping rewrite of the CSR Rules and Schedule VII; comments due 11 December
items.summary: Draft would bar CSR spend on one-off events, government schemes and corpus funds, make impact assessment voluntary, tighten implementing-agency registration and replace Schedule VII with a 14-item list.

items.title: Unspent CSR at BSE 200 firms climbs to a record ₹2,290 crore in FY26
items.summary: Hurun data show excess spending fell to ₹1,107 crore, leaving a net shortfall of ₹1,183 crore — the widest in over a decade — on total CSR spend of ₹18,922 crore.

items.title: EdelGive Hurun Philanthropy List 2026: ₹11,554 crore given in FY26, highly concentrated
items.summary: 219 donors gave 11% more than last year; 19 donors of ₹100 crore+ accounted for 68%. Healthcare giving rose 82% and environment 86%; Shiv Nadar and family top the list.

items.title: SFDR 2.0: EU lawmakers agree new Sustainable, Transition and ESG Basics fund categories
items.summary: The provisional Parliament–Council deal lets fossil-expanding companies sit in Transition funds only if 20% of capex goes to Taxonomy-aligned activities under a time-bound Paris-aligned plan. Rules apply two years after publication once formally endorsed.

items.title: TNFD urges the ISSB to turn nature-related disclosure into a mandatory standard by 2030
items.summary: Following the ISSB's November board meeting, the TNFD called for a full nature-related reporting standard rather than guidance, setting 2030 as its target date.

items.title: COP31 second week: carbon-market (Article 6.4) guidance and finance remain divisive
items.summary: Earth Negotiations Bulletin reports a decision on least developed countries, but splits over Article 6.4 supervisory-body guidance, the mitigation work programme and adaptation/loss-and-damage finance.

items.title: Sattva's 8th CSR report flags five areas where CSR misses India's biggest needs
items.summary: Catalytic CSR finds funding skewed to cancer over heart disease, to classroom skilling over work exposure, and away from the most groundwater-stressed states; it urges data-led, riskier bets.

items.title: Omnicom Global Solutions and Prayoga back hands-on STEM learning in government schools
items.summary: Interview with OGS's CFO on a CSR partnership with Prayoga focused on experiential science learning rather than rote memorisation.

items.title: ISSB meets in Frankfurt on 18–19 November; agenda papers published
items.summary: The International Sustainability Standards Board has released the agenda and supporting papers for its November board meeting.

items.title: Amazon to invest US$7 billion more in Indian renewables by 2030
items.summary: Adds four wind and solar projects (934 MW) in Karnataka, MP and Rajasthan; India contracted capacity will pass 2 GW.

items.title: ECB to run 'deep dives' on how banks manage climate and nature risks
items.summary: Supervisory scrutiny of climate and nature risk at euro-area banks is stepping up.

items.title: BII, Norfund and FinDev Canada team up to mobilise $10 billion of climate finance for emerging markets
items.summary: Development finance institutions pool efforts on climate capital for emerging economies, a group that includes India.

items.title: 16th India CSR Summit & Awards set for New Delhi on 21 November
items.summary: The summit's theme is future-ready CSR; useful for networking and award benchmarking.

items.title: K Raheja Corp earns a 4-star GRESB rating for 2026
items.summary: Real-estate developer's benchmark result, reported alongside other Indian corporate sustainability updates.

items.title: SAMHI Hotels publishes its first sustainability report
items.summary: A first-time reporter in hospitality — a sign that ESG reporting is spreading beyond the BRSR-mandated top 1,000.

items.title: Feeding India's 'Unboxing Joy' drive reaches 1.1 lakh children
items.summary: The campaign delivered play and learning gift boxes to children across the country.

items.title: National CSR Conclave on skills, education and the future workforce — Mumbai, 24 November
items.summary: The programme will cover new CSR regulations and Social Stock Exchange (ZCZP) instruments.

items.title: 48th Jamnalal Bajaj Awards to honour Gandhian social workers
items.summary: Annual awards recognise selfless service and social impact.

items.title: COP31 runs 9–20 November in Antalya, Türkiye
items.summary: Climate negotiations under the Turkish presidency, with Australia leading negotiations.

items.title: Muthoot Finance commits ₹1 crore to school sanitation, plus 11 community projects
items.summary: Toilet units for government schools with a focus on girls' menstrual hygiene; launched for the late M. G. George Muthoot's birth anniversary.

items.title: India's carbon market (CCTS) faces delays: only ~295 of ~750 plants have FY26 targets
items.summary: A September amendment dropped refineries and textiles for FY26, and steel targets are still pending.

items.title: UK finalises ESG-ratings regulation and plans mandatory human rights due diligence
items.summary: FCA rules (PS26/22) take effect June 2028; the government will bring a due-diligence duty for large businesses.

items.title: Joyalukkas Group founder announces ₹100 crore for housing, healthcare and education
items.summary: Large philanthropic allocation targeting vulnerable communities, women, students and patients.

items.title: CBRE partners Samarthanam and CABI to strengthen blind cricket
items.summary: Disability-inclusion CSR through sport, with a Give-Gold-certified implementing partner.

items.title: California SB 253: first-year Scope 1 and 2 reports were due 10 November
items.summary: Relevant for Indian groups with large US operations or US-parented subsidiaries.

items.title: ISSB: nearly 50 jurisdictions now on the path to its standards
items.summary: IFRS Foundation update notes the first wave of reports prepared under ISSB standards.

items.title: CSRBOX projects cumulative CSR of ₹5.5 lakh crore by 2030
items.summary: Annual CSR is estimated to pass ₹77,000 crore by 2030; the India CSR & ESG Summit is renamed One Purpos India Forum (press release).

items.title: ISSB proposes a Practice Statement on nature-related disclosures
items.summary: Exposure draft builds on TNFD; comments are open until 19 February 2027.

items.title: CECP Giving in Numbers 2026: giving steady overall, but most companies pulled back
items.summary: Median community investment rose, driven by top givers; 42% of companies expect 2026 budgets to fall.

items.title: ED uncovers ₹200 crore CSR racket routed through healthcare trusts
items.summary: About 40 PSUs and public sector banks donated to trusts allegedly used to turn CSR money into cash.

items.title: Corporate foundations are managing more money without more staff (CECP)
items.summary: Median transfer from a company to its foundation reached $10 million in 2025.

items.title: India's CSR spend hits a record ₹40,794 crore in FY 2024-25
items.summary: Up 17% year on year; education took the largest share and Maharashtra the largest state allocation.
